featured_reviews.review_text:
Want a new place to order that caters multi cuisine then Ohio is a must try!

I ordered three different dishes from three different cuisines and I loved all three!
I ordered the Chicken Katsu with red thai curry and jasmine rice which was my favourite and good quantity, It wasn’t heavy and really delicious and tried the Hummus and pita bread, It was the
perfect creamy snack. The Bolognese Pide was baked to perfection loved  the thoug and spices blended together!

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Penkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried out food from here. Neatly packed and no spillages. The quality was really great and the portion size was very filling
. Ordered chicken keema garlic bread. Had a crisp af crust with generous keema on top. Had a mild flavor of garlic and the keema flavor was too good !
.
The bucket chicken was definitely worth the pricing. The portion size was incredible. Crisp af coating and was spicy. The seasoning was generously sprinkled on the chicken. Chicken had a juicy interior.
.
The Texas bbq chicken with burnt garlic rice was good but i expected a better sauce. The bbq sauce had a bit too sweet taste. The rice and sauce was packed seperately. The rice was topped with tender grilled chicken breast and bits of pineapple.  Would have loved if the sauce was a bit les sweet and more savoury !

featured_reviews.name: Ishita Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
1. Paneer tikka roll: this tasted good and was saucy, the roll was made of maida which made it even tastier, i felt it should have been more cooked.

2. Quattro formaggi pizza: i am a cheese lover and this is why I ordered this 4 cheese pizza! It had distinct cheese taste and is thin crust.

3. Ohio Special Pizza: It was yummy with lot of toppings. Tasted good!

Overall good experience.

featured_reviews.name: Mansi Nikam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ohio!
A place located in Oshiwara serves some authentic continental, thai, North Indian food. Speaking genuinely the food is very delicious here. I recently ordered food from here they didn't fail to amaze me with their food. Me and my family really loved it. The packaging and delivery was pretty good.
The food which i ordered includes all of it..
1) Hummus and pita bread
2) paneer kadai
3) ohio special veg pizza

It is worth the try i really had a very good experience with this place.

I'd highly recommend this place to everyone.

featured_reviews.name: AyeAsh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was in the mood for chicken and rice, and I was recommended Ohio by one of my friends, and I absolutely loved all of the dishes I ordered! My order:

🍲🍱Chicken Katsu with red Thai curry and jasmine rice: The lemongrass flavour of Thai curry is what makes it one of my favourite dishes! the Japanese katsu style chicken was absolutely delicious, it felt very on point in recreating the original katsu flavour; and the jasmine rice paired perfectly with both the katsu and the curry, making for a perfect meal. This dish is a complete set for one, and it sufficient for satiating both the stomach and the heart :)

🍛🥡Texas style barbeque chicken with burnt garlic rice: Two things I love coming together: bbq and garlic, this dish was amazing, the bbq sauce was so good and paired well with the garlic rice

🍗💫Bucket chicken:
This was hands down the highlight of my order, the chicken was so flavourful and plenty, it was not just the skin that held the flavour, but the meat was so juicy and oozing flavour, absolutely would recommend this to everyone!
Loved the protective and sanitary packaging, and how they took care of cooking instructions, must try!

featured_reviews.name: Saquib Ziya
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a recently opened delivery outlet in Oshiwara serving Global cuisine.

Got to try below dishes:

Chicken Tikka Panini - Their bestseller and you'll come to know why when you order one! 😋

Korean Glaze Chicken - Sweet n spicy Chicken appetizer in traditional Korean sauce.

Bbq Chicken Texas with Burnt Garlic Rice - Perfect for a light and healthy meal.

Will try their other dishes soon! 😀😃

Good job Team Ohio! 👍🏼

featured_reviews.name: Sid Shingne
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sometimes it feels nice to eat something different than normal food. Ohio have some really good options. Your been calling from here now for quite a few months.

Definitely give a try to rosalie kabab which is a red marination chicken stuffed kebab. It has a very smoky and creamy taste.

Also try chicken tikka. Very tasty. And lots of red chilli marination. It is a party favourite.

Chicken teriyaki with hakka noodles. This comes in 1 combo type of plastic box where there is chicken teriyaki on one side and there is hakka noodles in one side. Absolutely perfect when only one person wants to eat Chinese and the other people want to eat Mughlai.

Ohio is a good place if you are looking for value for money and good quality and quantity in food

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Bulani
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered 3 dishes from this place. All 3 were commendable, really hats off to the chef here. Starting with the non veg pasta, it has become my favourite pasta so far just the amazing Alfredo sauce served piping hot is another level of satisfaction. The sauce is in ample amount so no issues there. Coming to the katsu chicken with red thai curry, mind blowing. Crispy katsu chicken well marinated served on a bed of basmati rice topped with the curry, heavenly combination. Just as a side got the hummus and pita I could tell the hummus was freshly made. I would definitely keep ordering pasta and katsu chicken with red thai curry

featured_reviews.name: Antara Trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text: Streets of Calcutta is now renewed at a spacious location in just opposite lane of its previous location, However one thing remains unchanged is the quality, taste and flavour of the food they serve. While they serve it exactly like kolkata, this place will always be close to your heart once you visit here. The puchkas are to die for. Makes you super nostalgic. The sone pe suhaga is just how fresh their food is. The drinks and the desserts are a plus on how good the food is. Must must visit. featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Khalid Sarfaraz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Streets of Calcutta is located on the main Oshiwara road and it is easy to find.

The seating is very limited hence call and confirm before visiting as mostly it is a takeaway outlet. I guess 4 people can sit inside.

The menu is Bengali cuisine and its super authentic. The menu is simple yet it offer variety. Prices are not high and quantity served is huge. Also they serve authentic in house made puchkas which was like the best that I have had apart from the ones which you get everywhere.

What We Had -
APPETISERS~
Chicken Moghlai Paratha with Aloor Dom -
One of the super heavy appetisers that you would come accept. Thick crispy paratha generously filled with minced chicken tasted perfect. Loved the taste of the filling as it had nice amount of spices used. The potato served along was also good but the paratha is a meal in itself.

MAINS~
Chicken Kosha with Luchi -
Chicken gravy with big version of puri tasted good. Again the gravy was flavourful and the puri was the best.

Veg Special Thali -
The veg thali consisted of all the below items and everything was really good. Loved eating everything in it.
Luchi, Aloor Dom, Dal Rice, Vegetable Curry, Crispy Veg Chop, Tangy Chutney, Mishti Doi.

So our meal at Streets of Calcutta Oshiwara was good however I wish they come up with a bigger outlet so we can enjoy the perfect dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sharmin Hazarika
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Streets of Calcutta for the second time. It’s a nice, cozy place that’s ideal for families looking to enjoy Bengali cuisine. My first visit was quite pleasant, which is why we decided to return.

During this visit, we ordered four fish thalis, a Basanti Pulao, Chicken Kosha, chutney, and two appetizers. Unfortunately, the service was a bit slow. The appetizers were tasty but one of the fish thalis was served undercooked, which we brought to the staff’s attention and requested to be replaced. There was no apt piece available so packed one piece of chicken as replacement.

Also, they don’t provide glass with plates.

While the ambiance and food are generally enjoyable, I hope the kitchen pays more attention to the cooking quality and service speed to ensure a consistently good experience.

featured_reviews.name: Aman SharmaJii
featured_reviews.review_text:
Streets of Calcutta is a decent spot if you're craving Bengali street food in Mumbai. The star of the visit was definitely the Puchka - absolutely amazing! It had the perfect flavour and left a lingering aftertaste that reminded me of Kolkata.

I also tried their Dal Kachori with Dum Aloo, but it felt more like a big Dal Puri than an actual kachori. The taste was okay - nothing special, just decent.

Overall, if you're from Bengal or Odisha and missing those familiar flavours, their Puchka and Jhal Muri will definitely hit the right notes. Simple place, but worth it for the taste of home.

featured_reviews.name: Irom Lamjingba
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered Fish Thali, Chicken Dagbangla, Dal with Egg Tadka, Basanti Pulao,luchi but the overall experience was extremely disappointing.

The fish in the thali was uncooked and the jhol was completely tasteless. Begun Bhaja seemed to be fried in contaminated oil, the dal was too bland, and the quantity of aloo jhuri was very less. Chicken Dagbangla was again tasteless with undercooked chicken and sweet.

After taking our order for Dal with Egg Tadka and Phulka Roti, the staff informed us after almost 19 minutes that roti was not available. Chicken Biryani was also unavailable. The staff insisted we try Basanti Pulao instead, but it was not good at all.

Service and staff behaviour were poor throughout. Even after requesting a refill for the aloo jhuri, there was no response for a long time, though they eventually refilled it.

Lastly, and most importantly, the restaurant is located next to a dump yard, which raises serious hygiene concerns.

Overall, a very bad experience. Definitely not recommended, and I will never visit again.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Tawa Tikka Restaurant and absolutely loved their newly launched menu. They serve an amazing variety of Mughlai, Tawa, Tandoor and Chinese food, and every dish we tried was full of flavour.
The Tawa Tikka Special Cheesy Starter was rich, cheesy and perfectly cooked. Their Kalimiri Roll, which is also their bestseller, truly stood out with its smoky, peppery taste and juicy filling. The Lemon Tandoori was soft, well-marinated and had a refreshing tangy flavour. The highlight for me was the Tawa Tikka Special Dragon Rice – a perfect fusion of desi spices and Chinese flavours.

Especially salman bhai was incredibly attentive and made excellent recommendations.will visit soon again Bhai..

Highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Amreen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday our family of five visited Tawa Tikka for Iftar after hearing great feedback from friends — and the experience truly exceeded our expectations.
Despite the heavy rush at Iftaar time, the manager/owner welcomed us warmly and ensured we were comfortably seated. The Iftaar plate was generously served and every single snack was absolutely delicious. When we requested a few additional items, they were added immediately without hesitation.
But what truly left us speechless was at the end when we asked for the bill. We were told that they do not charge anything for people who come to open their fast there or eat Iftaar inside. In today’s time, such generosity and sincerity are rare.
This noble gesture reflects not just great food, but even greater values. It’s places like these that restore faith in kindness and community spirit during Ramadan.
May Allah SWT reward them abundantly for this beautiful act of generosity and bless their business with immense barakah and success.
If you'd like, I can also make a short Google review version (5–6 lines but very powerful) which often gets more attention. ⭐

featured_reviews.name: Saad Lulania
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi myself , Mohammed Saad Lulania 😊
I would love to give the best review about
the Restaurant Tawa and Tikka in Jogeshwari
If you are in Jogeshwari West, Mumbai, and craving delicious, freshly made tawa items, then Tawa Tikka Restaurant is the ultimate spot you must try! Run by the ever welcoming and humble Mr. Faisal bhai, this place has become a go to destination for food lovers over the last two years and for all the right reasons.The manager of Tawa Tikka
Mr Sahil is very good and sweet humble guy who serves you really well good food
and also the staff has a gentlemen Aayush the kind nature and friendly nature of Ayush is very much impressive . Aayush helps you to take the order and also serves you well at Tawa Tikka Restaurant in few minutes .
No waiting or longer time is taken in preparation for the order . Too good food,
The moment you walk in, you're greeted with warmth and friendly smiles. The staff here are incredibly courteous, always attentive, and make sure your dining experience feels like home. What truly sets Tawa Tikka apart is their commitment to quality and hygiene. The kitchen is clean, the ingredients are always fresh, and every dish is prepared with a lot of love and care.
When it comes to food, Tawa Tikka truly delivers excellence on a plate. Their Chicken Rolls are hands-down the best in Jogeshwari perfectly spiced, juicy, and wrapped in soft, fresh parathas. The Chicken Baida Roti and Kalamiri Black pepper Chicken Roll is another crowd favorite crispy outside, stuffed with flavorful chicken and egg inside, making it a perfect blend of crunch and taste.
But the real star here is their tawa items a true celebration of rich Mughlai flavors! From spicy chicken fry to masaledar kebabs, every tawa dish is cooked to perfection using fresh vegetables, aromatic spices, and quality meat that melts in your mouth.
In just two years, Tawa Tikka has built a loyal customer base thanks to its consistent taste, clean environment, and the personal touch of Faisal bhai’s hospitality. Whether you're dining in or ordering out, the flavors, freshness, and friendly vibes will keep you coming back for more.
Highly recommended for all chicken lovers and street food fans in Mumbai!
Wish you the best Mr Faisal may Allah Swt make you very much successful to continue your restaurant ahead In sha Allah 💝🥳
Looking forward to come visit Tawa tikka with family and friends , thank you 😊👍🏻

featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this restaurant recently and had a really good dining experience. We tried the crab masala, surmai thali, mutton thali, chicken crispy, and soup. featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are hunting for genuine, no-fuss Konkani and Malvani food in Mumbai, your search ends at Konkan Swad in Jogeshwari West. This restaurant is truly a hidden gem, offering an unparalleled taste of the coast that transports you straight to the shores of Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg. It's the kind of place you visit when you crave authentic, home-style seafood and fiery curries.
The highlight here is, without a doubt, the seafood. The fish is always incredibly fresh—a mandatory requirement for any great coastal establishment. I highly recommend starting with the Bombil Fry (Bombay Duck) or the Surmai Fry. The coating is perfectly crisp, and the marinade is a flawless blend of chili, turmeric, and spice. For the main course, the Prawn Curry Thali is a masterpiece; rich, coconut-based gravy that pairs perfectly with the soft, fluffy Vade (puri made from rice and lentil flour). If you prefer meat, the Chicken Malvani Thali is equally robust and satisfying.
Beyond the main courses, don't miss out on the incredible Solkadhi. This kokam-based digestive drink is creamy, tangy, and absolutely essential for cooling the palate after the spicy Konkani flavors. It’s one of the best I've had outside of a Konkani home.
The ambiance is simple, clean, and unpretentious, allowing the focus to remain solely on the food, as it should be. The staff is warm, helpful, and eager to offer recommendations, making the entire dining experience feel incredibly homely. If you love coastal flavors, fresh fish, and authentic Malvani spices, Konkan Swad is a must-visit destination in Jogeshwari. Highly, highly recommended!
